description: A high-voltage DC line connected to an ACBus on each end, for operational simulations with a linearized DC power flow approximation and losses proportional to flow. For modeling a DC network, see TModelHVDCLine.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Unique among components of the same type; components of different types may share a name.

available.description: Whether the component is online (true) or offline (false). Unavailable components are excluded from simulations.

active_power_flow.description: Initial condition of active power flow on the line. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

arc.description: An Arc defining this line `from` a bus `to` another bus.

active_power_limits_from.description: Minimum and maximum active power flows to the FROM node. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

active_power_limits_to.description: Minimum and maximum active power flows to the TO node. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MW, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

reactive_power_limits_from.description: Minimum and maximum reactive power limits to the FROM node. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVAr, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

reactive_power_limits_to.description: Minimum and maximum reactive power limits to the TO node. Units: per power_units — NATURAL_UNITS: MVAr, COMPONENT_BASE: pu .

loss.description: Loss model coefficients: a linear model with constant loss and proportional rate (MW loss per MW flow), or a piecewise loss with N segments.

base_power.description: System base power for per-unitization of this component's per-unit fields, recorded per component in lieu of a system-level table. Units: MVA.

power_units.description: Unit basis for this component's power fields (power, ratings, ramp rates): COMPONENT_BASE per unit on base_power, NATURAL_UNITS the field's own unit.

title: TwoTerminalGenericHVDCLine
